text:
# filter.conditionMax

TL;DR:
- filter.conditionMax sets the highest allowed condition score.

What it means:
- It is mainly useful when the workflow wants to cap condition buckets rather than only set a minimum.

Agent hint:
- Use together with conditionMin when building a condition interval.
